'''John Gardiner''' (also published as '''John Gardner''') is a Star Wars CCG player. Nicknamed "Dum Dum" in Eric Bailey's Indiana reports, he finished last at the [[January 2001 Greenwood tournament]] with Deadbolt EBO<ref name="tr-d1654" /> and played at [[October 2001 Carmel tournament]] on 6 October 2001 with non-Objective D*II and [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base (space, Jar Jar)]], according to Eric Bailey's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3022">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-06-carmel-in-10-06-01d3022/ carmel-in-10-06-01], DeckTech (Eric "YOYOY" Bailey, 6 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-06-carmel-in-10-06-01d3022/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
